bio: Ideal for a romantic date night, this charming farmstead is the quintessence of poised and intimate and only offers tables for two (but there is a private room that caters to groups). Working hand in hand, Angélique manages the front-of-house while Tim runs the kitchen, in a bid to provide a personalised experience. Luxury ingredients enjoy the leading role on the menu and the chef might sign a high-flying combination of oysters and seaweed, caviar and a distinctive beurre blanc made out of curds. He has a soft spot for fresh, tangy notes, illustrated by the subtle sauce vierge that contrasts so wonderfully with the mild yet sweet flesh of turbot. A mouthwatering prospect…...
